items.t: What Does GSK (LSE:GSK) FDA Lung Cancer Approval Change For Investors?
items.sum: GSK (LSE:GSK) received FDA accelerated approval for Nelkarmi (neladalkib) in advanced ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer. The decision covers adults with previously treated ALK-positive NSCLC, including those with brain metastases or resistance to earlier ALK inhibitors. items.t: GSK Wins FDA Approval for Nuvalent-Acquired Nelkarmi in Lung Cancer
items.sum: GSK gains FDA accelerated approval for Nelkarmi in advanced ALK-positive lung cancer, strengthening its oncology portfolio.

items.t: GSK Marks Second Lung Cancer Drug Approval This Year
items.sum: FDA grants accelerated approval to neladalkib (Nelkarmi) for pretreated ALK-positive NSCLC, marking GSK's second lung cancer nod.

items.t: GSK wins FDA approval for lung cancer drug Nelkarmi
items.sum: Investing.com -- GSK Plc received US Food and Drug Administration approval for its lung cancer drug neladalkib, which will be marketed under the brand name Nelkarmi. The approval adds validation to the British drugmaker's acquisition of biotechnology company Nuvalent.
